test_objective: Check that an entity can be retrieved with two levels linked entities in different join types and representations
keywords: Create Initial Entity And Linked Entities
Delete Created Entity And Linked Entities

test_cases.name: 018_13_01 Inline Normalized
test_cases.doc: Check that an entity can be retrieved with two levels linked entities in different join types and representations
test_cases.setup: Create Initial Entity And Linked Entities
test_cases.teardown: Delete Created Entity And Linked Entities
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Retrieve Entity with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Retrieve Entity with Check Response Body Content and
            Query Parameter: expectation_filename set to 'linked-entity-retrieval/building-two-levels-inline-018-13.json' and
            Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response.json()' and
            Query Parameter: additional_ignored_path set to '${EMPTY}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${linking_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: join set to 'inline' and
    Query Parameter: joinLevel set to '2' and
    Query Parameter: options set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://easy-global-market.github.io/ngsild-api-data-models/ngsildTestSuite/ngsildTestSuiteV1.8-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
